findings.summary: shadcn base-nova accordion trigger styles disabled with aria-disabled:, but @base-ui/react 1.9.0 (mui/base-ui#5607) renders the native disabled attribute, so a disabled item looks enabled (full opacity, hover underline). Proposed fix PR https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/pull/12585 not merged; registry file unchanged.
Merged, not yet released: data-disabled reflects the part's own disabled.
hiddenUntilFound panels render plain hidden in server HTML. Not used by our gallery (SPA).
Accordion trigger has no visible keyboard focus in 4 of 8 shadcn themes; theme-specific, not m3.

notChecked: Reddit, Hacker News and blog searches were not run; only GitHub issue lists for mui/base-ui and shadcn-ui/ui were fetched (radix-ui/primitives not searched).

differences.where: Disabled item (third item of the first accordion)
differences.reference: Radix: trigger opacity 0.5, pointer-events none, no hover underline
differences.branch: Base UI: trigger has native disabled and data-disabled but the base-nova classes use aria-disabled:, so opacity 1 and pointer-events auto; looks enabled and shows hover underline
differences.how: Open /gallery#components, scroll to #accordion, compare the Disabled row on https://m3.khojlabs.com with the branch build

apiChanges: AccordionContent uses Panel; height var --radix-accordion-content-height became --accordion-panel-height
notes: Migration was applied temporarily, compared, then reverted. Icons kept as lucide (registry uses IconPlaceholder). Not checked: 390x844 viewport, keyboard and arrow navigation, open/close animation and its height variable, focus ring, expand/collapse screenshots. Run stopped after the disabled difference was confirmed in computed styles and screenshots.
reasonNotMoved: With @base-ui/react 1.9.x the shadcn base-nova accordion trigger styles disabled via aria-disabled:, but Base UI now sets the native disabled attribute, so the Disabled item in the gallery renders at full opacity with hover underline instead of Radix's 0.5 opacity (https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/issues/12582). Retry once the base-nova registry file uses disabled: or data-disabled: classes (PR https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/pull/12585), then re-run the full comparison including the animation height variable, keyboard and 390x844.
